Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning - good to align on goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC kicked off next week:

POC goal (what success looks like)
- Validate Redwood inference for Stellar Commerce search ranking and recommendation pipeline with 95th percentile latency <= 150ms and throughput to support peak traffic (~200 qps).
- Match or exceed current relevance baseline on the A/B eval set (NDCG@10 within 2%).
- Confirm data handling (no persistent customer data saved to our hosted logs for this POC).

Evaluation plan / artifacts
- Redwood will provide a staging endpoint and test harness (load + eval) for you to run against sample traffic.
- Success criteria doc and evaluation spreadsheet attached. Please confirm the metric thresholds.

Timeline
- Kickoff & env access: target Feb 23
- Baseline & smoke tests: Feb 24-26
- Full load/eval window: Mar 1-5
- Wrap & proposed next steps: Mar 8

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa (account lead) + Vivek (SE) + Aditya (eng triage)
- Stellar: Alex (product), Priya (eng)

Open items / risks
- Need access to a staging dataset and API keys.
- Potential rate-limit/auth behavior on their side may require tweaks.

Attachments: poc-scope-stellar-commerce.pdf, poc-success-criteria.xlsx

Can you confirm the success criteria and the proposed kickoff date? If that works I will send a calendar invite and Doc with pairing instructions.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi all - after doing an initial smoke run against the dataset Alex provided, we hit a reproducible failure when request concurrency exceeds ~220 RPS: auth token refresh logic currently races and causes intermittent 502s from the staging gateway. Details below:

- Failure mode: token refresh race -> invalidated session -> 502 gateway error. Observed under sustained burst load that mimics your peak.
- Impact: will affect throughput tests and could make our 95th latency numbers noisy; blocking for full load window.
- Short-term mitigation: 1) We can throttle client-side test harness to 200 RPS to complete baseline and eval; 2) We can enable a per-connection sticky token path in staging to avoid refresh races (config change) - low-risk and reversible.
- Long-term fix: patch to token refresh code; ETA for dev + canary in staging: 2026-02-28; full rollout to POC staging: 2026-03-02 (if canary looks good).

Action items:
- Aditya (eng): push config change to staging today to enable sticky tokens for the POC.
- Vivek (SE): coordinate with Priya for a short window to toggle config and validate.
- Marissa: please confirm that throttling to 200 RPS for the baseline window is acceptable to Stellar.

I'll add this to the POC risk tracker (blocking bug).

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: POC risk tracker update + escalation plan (Stellar Commerce)

Hi Alex & Priya - quick consolidation and next steps after the triage:

Summary of current blocking risk
- Token refresh race under sustained bursts >220 RPS -> intermittent 502s.
- Impact: affects load window and could skew latency results.

Mitigations & plan
1) Immediate config toggle: Vivek will enable sticky token path in staging today to stabilize the baseline (non-invasive, reversible). Owner: Vivek.
2) Throttled baseline: agree to run baseline at 200 RPS to complete initial evaluation. Owner: Stellar (Priya).
3) Patch & canary: Aditya will ship patch to dev+canary by 2026-02-28; staging rollout to follow 2026-03-02 pending canary results. Owner: Aditya.
4) Fallback & rollback: If patch causes regressions, we will rollback and keep sticky-token config for POC while we iterate. Owner: Aditya/Vivek.

Escalation path (critical fixes)
- Primary on-call: Aditya Rao (slack: @aditya; mobile: +1 (415) 555-0147) - first 2 hours for critical bug triage.
- SE escalation: Vivek Kulkarni (slack: @vivek; mobile: +1 (415) 555-0189).
- Manager escalation (business/SLA): Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodai.com; mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123).

Data handling confirmation
- Neha: we will provide a short retention statement for the sample dataset and confirm that logs for this POC are not persisted to shared analytics or external clusters. Neha will reply separately and we'll attach to the MAP.

Next steps
- We'll enable the sticky-token config and confirm with Priya when you're ready for a quick validation window (15-30 minutes).
- If all good, we'll proceed with baseline (200 RPS) Feb 26 then full eval window Mar 1-5 with patch on Mar 2 if canary passes.
- Weekly status updates: Fridays at 10:00 PT (first sync Mar 5).

Please confirm you're good with the mitigation plan and escalation contacts. I'll update the MAP and the tracker with the risk as "blocking" until the patch is in staging.

Thanks - Marissa
